_note: One row per spoken line. id = the wav name. shot = where it plays. cue = what must be on screen as the line starts (the reviewer and vosync use it). Write lines the way the character talks; keep each to one idea.

lines.text: Most people squat like this. Here are three fixes.
lines.cue: the wrong squat, knees caving in, already on screen

lines.text: One: push your knees out, right over your toes.
lines.cue: knees glow red on 'One', the fix and a green check land on 'out'

lines.text: Two: feet a bit wider than your hips, toes out a little.
lines.cue: boots glow on 'feet', toe arrows on 'toes'

lines.text: Three: don't fold forward. Chest up!
lines.cue: side view; the ghost tips forward on 'don't', upright on 'Chest up'

lines.text: Save this for your next workout.
lines.cue: end card with the three fixes listed
